title: Register for and pay the short-term rental accommodation levy
what: As a booking service provider, register with the Commissioner for ACT Revenue and pay the levy on each booking of short-term rental accommodation in the ACT made through the service.

sources.title: Short-Term Rental Accommodation Levy Act 2025 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 13 (current republication (R1, from 1 July 2025; Short-Term Rental Accommodation Levy Act 2025 | Acts))
sources.quote: STRA levy imposed on a short-term rental accommodation booking must be paid by the person who provided the booking service (the booking service provider) used to make the booking

sources.title: Short-Term Rental Accommodation Levy Act 2025 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 16 (current republication (R1, from 1 July 2025; Short-Term Rental Accommodation Levy Act 2025 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person is a booking service provider; and (b) the quarter mentioned in section 15 (2) before which the person must apply for registration as a booking service provider has ended

administration.who: ACT Revenue Office (Commissioner for ACT Revenue)

sources.title: Short-Term Rental Accommodation Levy Act 2025 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 15, words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current republication (R1, from 1 July 2025; Short-Term Rental Accommodation Levy Act 2025 | Acts)
sources.quote: The commissioner must register the applicant as a booking service provider.

reach.condition: if it provides a booking service for short-term rental accommodation in the ACT

assessment.summary: As a booking service provider, register with the Commissioner for ACT Revenue and pay the levy on each booking of short-term rental accommodation in the ACT made through the service.

marks.reason: The levy and quarterly returns add cost to each booking.
